help.title: How InboxZero Works
help.step1Body: Paste any URL or type your idea in the search bar above and press "Save Card" to capture it instantly. You can try it without signing up, for up to 20 free cards.
help.step2Body: Sign up with your email to keep your cards permanently in the cloud, without relying on this browser. Still free for up to 20 cards.
help.step3Body: Quickly access your cards from the side menu or the "My Library" dropdown in the top bar, without losing anything.

installGuide.title: Add InboxZero to your desktop or phone
installGuide.step1Body: Open InboxZero.es, click the three dots in the top right (or the install icon in the address bar) and choose "Install InboxZero.es" or "Create shortcut...". The icon will be ready on your desktop.
installGuide.step2Body: Open InboxZero.es in Safari, tap the share icon (the square with an upward arrow) and choose "Add to Home Screen". The icon will appear alongside your other apps.
installGuide.step3Body: Open InboxZero.es in Chrome, tap the three dots in the top right and choose "Add to Home screen" or "Install app". Confirm and the icon will appear on your home screen.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Personal data processing under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the LOPDGDD. Data controller / contact: soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data collected through InboxZero.es is InboxZero.
Data protection and support contact: soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 2. Data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the service, we may process:
list: Account data: email address, encrypted password and, if provided, name.
Billing data: handled directly by Stripe (payment email, last 4 digits of the card, charge history and subscription identifier); InboxZero does not store the full card number.

Library content: saved URLs, automatically extracted title/description/image, categories, tags, notes and favourites. In Guest mode, this data stays only in the user’s browser (localStorage) and does not reach our servers until it is migrated to an account.
Technical data: IP address, device/browser type and security logs, as needed to provide and protect the service.
Support communications: the content of messages sent via “Talk to Support”.

sections.heading: 3. Artificial intelligence
paragraphs: InboxZero does not currently use any artificial intelligence system to process, analyse or generate content from your data or cards. If a feature of this kind is added in the future, you will be duly informed and, where required, consent will be requested before it is activated.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process data in order to:
list: Provide the InboxZero service and manage the account (performance of a contract / pre-contractual steps).
Manage subscriptions, payments and support (contract and legitimate interests).
Comply with legal obligations (e.g. tax or security).
Improve security and prevent abuse (legitimate interests).
Send essential service communications; marketing only with consent where required.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share only the data strictly necessary with the providers who help us deliver the service, under contract and with appropriate safeguards:
list: Supabase: authentication, database and library storage.
Stripe: payment processing and subscription management. You can read their privacy policy at stripe.com/privacy.
ScrapingBee, ZenRows and Microlink: automatic extraction of metadata (title, description, image) from saved URLs; they do not store the content permanently.
Cloudflare Turnstile: bot protection on sign-up and sign-in.
Railway and Vercel: hosting of the backend and the frontend.
Hostinger: handling of support email (soporte@inboxzero.es).
Holded (planned, not yet active): issuing invoices when formal billing is enabled.

sections.heading: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We retain account and library data while the account is active. If you request complete deletion of the account, it enters a 30-day grace period (during which you can recover it with no loss); if you do not return within that period, the data is permanently deleted.
Billing data is kept separately for the period required by tax law (usually 6 years in Spain), regardless of when the account is deleted.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You may exercise rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, by writing to:
soporte@inboxzero.es
You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or another competent supervisory authority.

sections.heading: 8. Security and minors
paragraphs: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect data. The service is not directed at children under 14 (or the applicable minimum age). If you become aware of a child’s data processed without authorisation, contact soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect legal or service changes. The current version will be published in the app. Enquiries: soporte@inboxzero.es.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Information about cookies and similar technologies on InboxZero.es. Contact: soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. They can remember preferences, keep you signed in or help us understand how the service is used.

sections.heading: 2. Types of cookies we may use
list: Technical/necessary cookies: essential for operation (e.g. session, security, language or local preference storage).
Preference cookies: remember choices such as interface language.
Analytics cookies (planned, not yet active): will help us understand aggregated usage to improve the service; they will only be enabled after explicit consent via the cookie banner.
Third-party cookies: set by providers (e.g. authentication or payments) under their own policies.

sections.heading: 3. Legal basis
paragraphs: Strictly necessary cookies rely on legitimate interests / necessity to provide the requested service. Other cookies, when used, will be placed after consent where required by law.

sections.heading: 4. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can configure your browser to refuse or delete cookies. Disabling technical cookies may affect InboxZero (sign-in, language, etc.).
Your choice regarding non-essential cookies is stored in your own browser and you can change it at any time from the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.
For help managing cookies or related rights: soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 5. Updates
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. The version published in the app applies. Contact: soporte@inboxzero.es.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: Terms of use for the InboxZero service. Support: soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By registering, subscribing or using InboxZero, you accept these Terms and Conditions, the Legal Notice and the Privacy Policy. If you disagree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: 2. Service description
paragraphs: InboxZero is an application that lets you save, organise and browse links and knowledge as cards. Features may evolve; material changes will be communicated where appropriate.
InboxZero is available to individuals as well as self-employed professionals, SMEs and companies, with no distinction in the sign-up process.

sections.heading: 3. User account
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for activity under your account. Report any unauthorised use immediately to soporte@inboxzero.es.

sections.heading: 4. Free plan and Premium subscription
paragraphs: The Free plan lets you save up to 20 cards at no cost. The Premium plan removes that limit and costs €3.99/month or €29.99/year (VAT included).
Billing or cancellation enquiries: soporte@inboxzero.es.
list: Payment is taken when you confirm checkout and renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel.
By subscribing, you expressly request immediate access to the service and waive your 14-day right of withdrawal, via a required checkbox at checkout.
You may cancel at any time from your account. Premium access remains active until the end of the period already paid, with no further charges.

If a renewal charge fails, Stripe automatically retries the payment and Premium access is kept in the meantime; if payment ultimately fails, the account reverts to Free, restoring the 20-card limit without deleting cards already saved.
Switching between the monthly and annual plans is currently handled by contacting soporte@inboxzero.es.
General no-refund policy, except where legally required in a specific case (for example, a duplicate charge caused by an InboxZero error).

InboxZero may change its prices for objective reasons (service evolution, new features, operating costs, inflation or legal changes such as VAT). Any change will be notified by email at least 30 calendar days in advance; if you do not accept it, you may cancel your subscription without penalty before the new price takes effect. The first charge after the new price comes into force, without prior cancellation, will be treated as acceptance of the new rate.

sections.heading: 5. User content
paragraphs: You retain at all times the ownership and rights in the content you save in InboxZero. By using the service, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive licence to store, reproduce, process, back up and synchronise that content, solely to the extent needed to provide the service. InboxZero does not acquire ownership of your content. You also warrant that you have sufficient rights in that content and that it does not infringe third-party rights or the law.

sections.heading: 6. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must not use the service for unlawful activity, spam, system abuse, harassment or illegal content. InboxZero may suspend or terminate accounts for serious breaches.

sections.heading: 7. Complaints about third-party content
paragraphs: If someone believes that a card saved by an InboxZero user infringes their intellectual property rights, contains their personal data without consent, or includes unlawful material, they may notify soporte@inboxzero.es stating: (a) their identity, (b) the specific card or URL affected, (c) the reason for the complaint, and (d) a contact method. InboxZero will review the notice and, where appropriate, may restrict access to that card or suspend the account involved while the matter is resolved. Complaints that are clearly unfounded or made in bad faith may be dismissed without further action.

sections.heading: 8. Availability and limitation of liability
paragraphs: The service is provided “as is” within reason. To the extent permitted by law, InboxZero is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits or data loss outside its reasonable control, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: 9. Cancellation and account deletion
paragraphs: You may cancel your Premium subscription at any time and keep using InboxZero on the Free plan; your cards are not deleted for this reason, although you will not be able to add new cards while you have more than 20 saved.
list: You may request complete deletion of your account. It then enters a 30-day grace period during which it is suspended but nothing is erased; if you sign in again within that period, you recover your account and cards exactly as you left them.
After 30 days without you returning, deletion becomes final and irreversible.
Before deleting the account, or during the grace period, you may export your cards to a downloadable file.
Billing data is kept separately for the period required by tax law, regardless of account deletion.

sections.heading: 10. Prevailing language
paragraphs: These legal documents are available in Spanish, English, French, German and Portuguese. In the event of a discrepancy or doubt of interpretation between versions, the Spanish version shall prevail, as it is the original drafting language and that of the jurisdiction applicable to the service.

sections.heading: 11. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may amend these terms by publishing an updated version in the app. Continued use after the effective date may constitute acceptance where allowed by law.
Support and complaints: soporte@inboxzero.es.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q0: What happens when I reach the free plan limit?
faq.a0: You can still view your 20 saved cards, but to add new ones you'll need to upgrade to Premium. Nothing is deleted from your library.
faq.a1: Yes, you can cancel your Premium subscription at any time from your account, with no lock-in and no penalty.
faq.a2: Yes. Each user can only access their own data, protected by secure authentication and database-level isolation.
faq.q3: Does it work with Instagram or Facebook?
faq.a3: Yes, InboxZero can extract information from social media links, as well as articles, videos and web pages in general.
faq.q4: Do I need a card to try it?
faq.a4: No. The Free plan doesn't require a card and lets you save up to 20 entries at no cost.
faq.q5: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a5: No, InboxZero works directly from your browser, with no app to install.
faq.q6: Can I access it from my phone?
faq.a6: Yes, InboxZero works on any device with a browser, including phones and tablets.
faq.q7: Is the free plan really free?
faq.a7: Yes, the Free plan has no cost and never expires; it simply has a limit of 20 saved entries.
